Synopsis:
Obituary of Édouard Balladur (1929–2026), French centre-right Prime Minister (1993–1995). Key highlights: architect of France's privatisation wave (SocGen, Paribas, TF1), pension reform architect (1993), mentor to Sarkozy and Bazire, failed 1995 presidential bid against Chirac, and decades-long legal saga over the "Karachi scandal" — ultimately acquitted in 2021.
